title: After the Tenno Sho (Autumn): Follow Your Heart

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin crosses the finish line in the autumn Tenno Sho alongside the dreams of many, with a smile of pure joy on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her doubts are gone. She's going to keep enjoying running for herself. And I bet she'll turn all those cheers into her driving force.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For our next race, too, we should go with the one she'll enjoy most. We decide on…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to set the Japan Cup, a race in which runners from around the world compete, as our goal. It's time for Ines and I to get our prep work started.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Goal Race is now the Arima Kinen.
The Arima Kinen, a race that draws the attention of many racing fans, makes for a fitting goal. It's time for Ines and I to get our prep work started.
